components.name: Relation-conditioned witness precision for radical-support collapse
components.project_addition: Use radical as an explicit finite multiplicative-support collapse, expose the forgotten multiplicity residual with exact integer coordinates, separate exact operation descent from witness-mediated control, reinterpret relation-adapted witness families through task-relative witness cost/precision, and compare this with scale-dependent exceptional incidence. The project does not claim the underlying radical, Mason-Stothers, arithmetic-derivative, Wronskian, derivation-generalization, or exceptional-set mathematics.
